newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber mostly down in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber mostly down in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly lower in sluggish after-hours trading on Thursday, pressured by sporadic selling from private investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was up 0.4 yen at 139.6 yen. Volume was 5,176 lots.

The market started the day on a weaker tone, reflecting the yen's firmer tone against the dollar. Amid a dearth of fresh factors, private investors continued to straddle the sidelines. "The market direction hinges on the currency market and the spot expiry next week," one trader said.
